levels.name: Infinite Circuit
levels.description: Lisa regenerates 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding Violet Arc. A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

levels.name: Electromagnetic Field
levels.description: Holding Violet Arc has the following effects: Increases DEF by 25%. Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption.

levels.name: Resonant Thunder
levels.description: Increases the Level of Lightning Rose by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Plasma Eruption
levels.description: Lightning Rose now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks.

levels.name: Electrocute
levels.description: Increases the Level of Violet Arc by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Pulsating Witch
levels.description: When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of Violet Arc's Conductive status onto nearby opponents. This effect can only occur once every 5s.
